'''Hera Tani''' is a ship Engineer based at '''The Jet's Hole''' in the '''Kuwemaki''' system. Her talent for power-management systems developed at an early age, and her workshop specialises primarily in ship power systems.<ref name="edwiki-hera">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Hera_Tani Hera Tani], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Hera provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Power Plant|Power Plants]] and the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]]. Her [[Power Distributor]] and [[Sensors]] services reach Grade 3.<ref name="inara-hera">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/12/ Hera Tani — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Kuwemaki
* '''Body:''' Kuwemaki A 3 a
* '''Facility:''' The Jet's Hole
* '''Allegiance:''' Empire
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship power systems and sensors
* '''Referral required:''' [[Liz Ryder]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Hera Tani has three stages:<ref name="inara-hera" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Liz Ryder]] to receive her referral.
# Reach the '''Imperial Navy rank of Outsider or higher'''.
# Provide '''50 units of [[Kamitra Cigars]]''' at The Jet's Hole.

The Imperial Navy rank and commodity contribution are separate conditions. The complete ordered process, including rank progression and rare-commodity delivery, belongs to [[Unlocking Hera Tani]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Hera Tani increases by:<ref name="inara-hera" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling commodities at The Jet's Hole.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Hera supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-hera" />

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add three Operations-era services to Hera's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-hera" />

* '''Long Range Detailed''' [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-dss">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Balanced''' [[Power Distributor]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-balanced">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/208/ Power Distributor — Balanced], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Support Focused''' [[Power Distributor]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-support">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/209/ Power Distributor — Support Focused], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Hera Tani blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Hera Tani directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with her:

* '''[[Broo Tarquin]]'''<ref name="inara-broo">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/15/ Broo Tarquin — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Tiana Fortune]]'''<ref name="inara-tiana">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/16/ Tiana Fortune — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own meeting or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
